settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure how Humano works for your company
settings.range: Enter a value in the allowed range

company.identityHint: How your company appears across Humano, payslips and documents.
company.name: Company name
company.domainHint: Used for links and email suggestions, e.g. acme.com
company.workspaceHint: Your sign-in organization; contact support to change it.
company.localeHint: Times are recorded and shown in this timezone; amounts default to this currency.
company.legalHint: You are the controller of your staff's data in Humano; we process it for you under our Data Processing Addendum.
company.legalDpa: Data Processing Addendum — print a copy to sign
company.legalNotice: Privacy notice template for your employees
company.timezoneHint: Clock-ins, schedules and payroll dates use this timezone.
company.currencyHint: Used for new compensations and payroll.

payroll.workingTimeHint: A normal working day and week — used for timesheet targets, hourly pay and overtime.
payroll.monthlyHint: A {{ n }} h month matches your weekly hours (× 52 ÷ 12).
payroll.overtimeHint: Pay rate for overtime hours, e.g. 1.5 = time and a half.
payroll.payDefaultsHint: What new compensations and pay runs start from.
payroll.payRulesHint: Formulas for earnings, deductions and employer charges.
payroll.leavePayHint: How sick, parental and unpaid leave are paid.
payroll.templatesHint: Statutory taxes and contributions for your country, kept up to date by Humano.
payroll.calendarsHint: How often people are paid and when; each calendar generates its pay periods.
payroll.calendarTz: Periods follow the company timezone ({{ tz }}).
payroll.switchOffBody: It stops generating pay periods and leaves this list. Runs already made are kept.

lists.name: Name
lists.codeHint: Stable identifier used by integrations — letters, numbers and _ only.
lists.offeredHint: Hidden entries stay on existing records but can't be picked anymore.
lists.deleteBody: This removes it from the list. Entries still used by employees can't be deleted — switch them off instead.
lists.inUse: This entry is still in use — switch it off instead of deleting it.

employmentTypes.title: Employment types
employmentTypes.hint: Full time, part time, contractor… shown on profiles and contracts.

jobLevels.title: Job levels
jobLevels.hint: Seniority steps such as junior, mid, senior, lead.

jobGrades.title: Job grades
jobGrades.hint: Pay grades used for salary bands.

employeeCategories.title: Employee categories
employeeCategories.hint: How people are classified, e.g. staff, management, contractor.

terminationReasons.title: Termination reasons
terminationReasons.hint: Why employment ended — used when someone leaves.

access.canSignInHint: Switched-off accounts keep their data but can't sign in.
access.selfHint: You can't switch off your own account.
access.effective: {{ roles }} roles · {{ perms }} permissions in total

billing.planHint: Your Humano subscription. To change plan or payment details, contact Humano support.
billing.invoicesHint: What Humano has billed your company.
billing.planHintManage: Your Humano subscription. Change plan or billing cycle below, or end the subscription.
billing.cancelScheduled: Your subscription ends on {{ date }}. Your workspace stays open until then.
billing.ended: Your subscription has ended. Choose a plan below to continue.
billing.changeHint: Upgrades and downgrades apply right away; the new price is billed from your next invoice.
billing.cancelHint: Your subscription stops renewing and ends at the close of the current period. You can change your mind until then.
billing.cancelConfirmBody: It will end on {{ date }}. Until then everything keeps working, and you can keep the subscription after all.
billing.changeConfirmBody: Your plan changes now; you will be billed {{ amount }} {{ cycle }} from your next invoice.
billing.chooseConfirmBody: Your subscription starts today at {{ amount }} {{ cycle }}.
billing.cancelled: Your subscription will end at the close of this period
billing.demoHint: This workspace is a demo set up by Humano, with a sample company to explore.
billing.demoKeep: Want to keep it? Talk to your Humano contact — we can turn this workspace into your own, on the plan you choose.
billing.trialThenPlan: Free until {{ date }}, then this plan starts
billing.trialChooseConfirmBody: Your free trial continues until {{ date }}. Then this plan starts and you are billed {{ amount }} {{ cycle }}.

trial.daysLeft: {{ n }} days left in your free trial.
trial.readOnly: Your free trial has ended. This workspace is read-only until {{ date }}, then it is paused. Its data is kept for {{ days }} days after the trial ended, then deleted.
trial.askAdmin: Ask an administrator to choose a plan.

terms.updated: We have updated our Terms of Service and Data Processing Addendum. They apply from your next renewal; please review and accept them for your company.
terms.notAccepted: Your company has not yet accepted our Terms of Service and Data Processing Addendum. Please review and accept them.
terms.accepted: Thank you — the updated terms are accepted.
terms.outdated: Our terms changed again since this page was opened. Reload the page and review them before accepting.
terms.failed: The terms could not be accepted. Please try again.

plan.moduleReadOnlyNoPlan: {{ name }} isn't included in your plan. You can view what's here, but not make changes.
plan.usageHint: Your {{ plan }} plan, and how much of it you use.
plan.limitReachedHint: Limit reached: choose a bigger plan to add more.
plan.downgradeOver: You have {{ used }} {{ unit }}; {{ plan }} allows {{ limit }}. You'll keep them, but can't add more.
plan.downgradeModule: {{ name }} isn't in {{ plan }}: it becomes read-only. Nothing is deleted.
plan.storageAddonHeld: Includes {{ packs }} × {{ size }} GB extra · {{ price }} / month
plan.storageDialogBody: Add storage in packs of {{ size }} GB at {{ price }} a month each.
plan.storageBillingNote: Available right away. Billed monthly on top of your subscription, from your next bill. Remove packs any time, as long as your files still fit.
plan.downgradeStorageAddon: Your extra storage ({{ packs }} × {{ size }} GB) isn't available on {{ plan }} and is removed.
